text_block_list.name: Bono's Fan A
text_block_list.text: "Your showdown with Taiki-san at the Yasuda Kinen was seriously intense and totally awesome~!"

text_block_list.name: Bono's Fan B
text_block_list.text:
Right? She really puts that physique to good use.
The way she accelerates hard coming around the final corner
just totally glued my eyes to her~!

text_block_list.name: Bono's Fan B
text_block_list.text: It was so refreshing, I'm glad I watched. It made me feel like, "I'll do my best again tomorrow too"... Really cheered me up.

text_block_list.name: Bono's Fan A
text_block_list.text: "Fufu. It'll definitely be another great race today. I can't wait~!"

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe...
I really am so happy.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: I did loooots of training just for our fight!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: I won't hand over today's win to anyone! Are you ready?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Yeah!
Ehehe, I'll give it my all today too!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
(...Thank you for indulging my selfishness,
Trainer.)

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
(Deep down, you probably wanted to
decide what to do right away, didn't you?)

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
(I'll see it through with my own eyes today.
And then, I'll decide my future...!)

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: All right, I'm gonna give it my all~~!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Amidst the grandstands brimming with soaring anticipation... the curtain rose on the Sprinters Stakes.
